decisions.reason: s0093 Chinese 〈（即遮塵。）〉 is a parenthetical gloss; the idiomatic before drops the opening parenthesis and retains a trailing corner bracket 〉. The proposed English restores a clean gloss.
The same annotation in s0093 leaves a corrupted 〉 on the literal; removing that closer while keeping “(that is, dust covers.)” matches the Chinese parenthetical.
s0208 〈（或黃線羅。）〉 is a variant parenthetical; the idiomatic before lacks the opening parenthesis, omits the period, and keeps 〉. The proposed “(or yellow cord gauze.)” restores the gloss.
The literal narrates “close bracket〉” instead of rendering 〈（或黃線羅。）〉; stripping that OCR noise to “(or yellow cord gauze.)” is correct.
s0176 ends 至殿上降輿 with only dismounting; unlike s0175’s 降輿升輅, there is no ascent. Removing invented “ascended and” restores the Chinese.
郡王妃及郡主 are consorts of commandery princes and commandery ladies, not “princesses and their daughters”; the proposed idiomatic matches the titles and the unit’s own literal.

decisions.after: First year of Yongle, imperial son-in-law Commandant Hu Guan exceeded regulations by riding Prince Ji Xi of Jin's red-framed brown palanquin, and was impeached by Supervising Secretary Zhou Jing.
decisions.reason: s0332’s 朱<車尞> is the decomposed form of 轑; CText Mingshi 輿服一 reads 朱轑棕轎, not 朱轓. Drop the OCR bracket narration, but do not invent “red-fendered”; “red-framed brown palanquin” matches the attested 朱轑.
宣德中少保黃淮 separates the Xuande period from the office 少保; without a comma, “Xuande Junior Guardian” fuses the reign into the title. The proposed comma restores that boundary.
s0363’s <革佔> is unreadable OCR; CText restores 䩞用描銀 (saddle ornament/flap). Replacing the bracket gloss with “saddle flaps” is accurate English even though the proposal mislabels the glyph as 韂.
Parallel <革佔> in s0364 is likewise 䩞 in CText (䩞用油畫); “saddle flaps used oil painting” correctly replaces the OCR bracket narration.
s0365 repeats the same corrupt <革佔>; CText’s 䩞用油畫 supports “saddle flaps used oil painting” over the bracket gloss.
s0367’s 黑綠油<革佔> is 黑綠油䩞 in CText; “black-green oiled saddle flaps” removes the OCR narration without changing the fittings sense.
